name: Wandering Through the Desolate Corridors
take: The node this account owned for months without knowing. Her chainsaw skills gain interrupt immunity, and every Unseen Snare she inflicts hands her +30% ATK for 15s — near-permanent, marking is her job — plus a 61,803 fixed Havoc DMG detonation, once per target, non-scaling, capped at chunking them to 61.80% HP. A free opener nuke stapled to the mark she was already applying. The pocky was hiding a knife.

name: Into the Web of Endless Bonds
take: THE team node, and the one the entire internet prices her by. She ignores 10% Havoc RES herself — fine — but the real clause: nearby Resonators holding Thread of Bane gain 50% All-Attribute DMG Bonus. That converts her Outro from a DEF-math gift into a full second support kit. Every sim where Chisa looks untouchable assumes this node. Not owned yet — the gap between S1 and S2 is the biggest on her whole chain.

name: Across the Confusion of the Long Night
take: The selfish node: Sawring - Blitz, the Chainsaw Dodge Counter, and Eradication all get their DMG Multipliers raised by +120% — stacking with Woven Myriad's +120% from the Liberation — and Ring consumed feeds Eradication a second +120% lane on top. Plus half the Vibration damage while she saws. The support stops moonlighting as a DPS and just IS one.

name: Severing the Endless Cycle of Tragic Fate
take: One line, huge lever: Unseen Snare's Havoc Bane trigger drops from once every 2s to once per second. Double the stack rate means the 12% DEF shred ceiling arrives in half the time and survives sloppier uptime. The quiet node that makes every OTHER buff in her kit punctual.

name: Thousands of Lights to Guide the Way Home
take: Moment of Nihility gains +100% DMG — the ult that already heals the team now hits like it resents them — and Lifethread - Glide costs half the Jetstream, so the aerial pull-dodge stops rationing itself. Quality of life for the hands, a doubled nuke for the scoreboard.

name: Thus, Hope is Rekindled with the Rising Dawn
take: The finale: fatal blows during her chainsaw skills leave her at 1 HP instead of dead, and Unseen Snare evolves into Finality — marked targets take +30% Amplified DMG from ALL Negative Statuses and +40% increased DMG from Chisa herself. The mark that made the team stronger now makes the STATUSES stronger. Every Bane crew citizen gets paid twice.
